questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the anatomy of the gallbladder is false?

options.label: A
options.text: Valves of Heister are present around the neck of the gallbladder

options.label: B
options.text: Gall bladder has a very thick submucosal layer

options.label: C
options.text: Hartmann's pouch may hinder safe dissection of the cystic pedicle

options.label: D
options.text: Phrygian cap anomaly is not an indication for cholecystectomy
